response.sql:
WITH scan_rates AS (
  SELECT s."riskeval", sc."gbsize" / NULLIF(sc."spanmin", 0) AS rate
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON s."zoneregistry" = sc."zoneref"
), group_rates AS (
  SELECT "riskeval", AVG(rate) AS rate
  FROM scan_rates
  GROUP BY "riskeval"
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM group_rates
)
SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS average_rate,
       AVG(g.rate - b.rate) AS average_margin_above_benchmark
FROM group_rates AS g
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE g.rate > b.rate;

assumptions.assumption: Each status group's rate is the average of the individual matched scans' gbsize/spanmin ratios; scans with a zero duration or missing size or duration have no rate. The final aggregate returns one row with NULL averages if no group is strictly above the benchmark.

alternatives.interpretation: If a group's rate should instead be its total file size divided by its total scan duration, calculate each group rate from the sums before taking the plain average across groups.
alternatives.sql:
WITH group_rates AS (
  SELECT s."riskeval",
         SUM(sc."gbsize") / NULLIF(SUM(sc."spanmin"), 0) AS rate
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON s."zoneregistry" = sc."zoneref"
  GROUP BY s."riskeval"
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM group_rates
)
SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS average_rate,
       AVG(g.rate - b.rate) AS average_margin_above_benchmark
FROM group_rates AS g
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE g.rate > b.rate;
